native_gateway_fail.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.combat_v2_fail(p_code text, p_message text, p_status integer, p_request_key uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_details jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not (p_code=any(public.combat_v2_error_codes())) then
    raise exception using errcode='P0001',message='COMBAT_V2_CODICE_ERRORE_NON_CANONICO';
  end if;
  raise sqlstate 'PGRST' using
    message=jsonb_build_object('code',p_code,'message_it',p_message,
      'retryable',p_status in (409,429,500,502,503,504),'request_key',p_request_key,
      'details_sanitized',case when jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_details,'{}'::jsonb))='object' then coalesce(p_details,'{}'::jsonb) else '{}'::jsonb end)::text,
    detail=jsonb_build_object('status',p_status)::text;
end $function$
